title: Simple Lootboxes
body:
# How it works
Right-click

Break

## uses
what can be dropped from the lootbox

<details>
<summary>Forge</summary>

**forge:hasi/lootbox_drops**
> e.g:
- Axes
- PLanks
- Flowers

</details>

<details>
<summary>Neoforge</summary>

still **"forge:hasi/lootbox_drops"**

</details>

<details>
<summary>How will the lootbox drop?</summary>

1. Get a Transmitter (can be found by natrual chest spawns)
2. Right-Click (best If You have an open sky)
3. The lootbox will slowly fall down from the sky

</details>
